points.description: Names cetyl alcohol (hexadecanol) as an evaporation inhibitor chemical.
Names stearyl alcohol (octadecanol) as an evaporation inhibitor chemical.

rubric.notes: Full marks (2) for naming both cetyl alcohol (hexadecanol) and stearyl alcohol (octadecanol); either name or formula-style wording is fine, and minor spelling slips are accepted. Give 1 mark if only one is named, or if the student gives a vague answer like "fatty alcohols" or "long-chain alcohols". Give 0 for unrelated chemicals. Extra wrong items do not cost marks unless they contradict the answer.
